title: Figure 2: Numerically computed probability density function of Y = ln(N)
description: Small plot titled 'PROB. DENSITY FUNCTION OF Y=ln(N)', with probability density of Y (0-0.4) versus 'Independent variable Y = ln(N)' (0-12), showing a curve with gaps.
